__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: Select the InfluxDB data source that reads the solark bucket.

targets.query:
from(bucket:"${bucket}")
  |> range(start:-1h)
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>r._field=="value")
  |> filter(fn:(r)=>contains(value:r.entity_id,set:["${entity_prefix}1_heat_sink_temperature","${entity_prefix}1_battery_temperature","${entity_prefix}1_load_total_power","${entity_prefix}1_load_l1_power","${entity_prefix}1_load_l2_power","${entity_prefix}1_inverter_total_power","${entity_prefix}1_inverter_l1_power","${entity_prefix}1_inverter_l2_power","${entity_prefix}1_inverter_l1_l2_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_inverter_l1_n_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_inverter_l2_n_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_load_frequency","${entity_prefix}1_load_l1_current","${entity_prefix}1_load_l2_current","${entity_prefix}1_pv_total_power","${entity_prefix}1_pv1_power","${entity_prefix}1_pv2_power","${entity_prefix}1_pv3_power","${entity_prefix}1_pv1_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_pv2_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_pv3_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_pv1_current","${entity_prefix}1_pv2_current","${entity_prefix}1_pv3_current","${entity_prefix}1_battery_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_battery_current","${entity_prefix}1_battery_power","${entity_prefix}1_grid_total_power","${entity_prefix}1_grid_l1_power","${entity_prefix}1_grid_l2_power","${entity_prefix}1_grid_l1_current","${entity_prefix}1_grid_l2_current","${entity_prefix}1_grid_l1_l2_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_grid_l1_n_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_grid_l2_n_voltage","${entity_prefix}1_grid_frequency"]))
  |> group(columns:["entity_id"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn:(r)=>({r with row:"latest"}))
  |> keep(columns:["row","entity_id","_value"])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["row"],columnKey:["entity_id"],valueColumn:"_value")
